xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF for #6173: containedDestExec win32 shell for pnpm.CMD lockfile refresh

plan.title: bug(win32,update): containedDestExec still execFileSync pnpm.CMD without shell — #5383 residual lockfile refresh EINVAL

references.title: Issue #6173: containedDestExec still execFileSync pnpm.CMD without shell
Issue #5383: parent Windows pnpm.CMD shell spawn

narratives.Description: Windows update/lockfile refresh still launches pnpm.CMD via bare execFileSync inside containedDestExec. Node refuses .CMD without a shell (CVE-2024-27980) → EINVAL → pin rollback. Launcher PM helpers already use shell:true on win32 (#5383).
narratives.UserStory: As a Windows consumer with standalone pnpm.CMD on PATH, I want directive update lockfile refresh to succeed, so that pin rollback does not fire from EINVAL.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Fix containedDestExec to pass shell: process.platform === "win32" (same #5383 portable pattern as launcher PM helpers).
2. Add unit/regression coverage that win32 + .CMD path gets shell:true and non-win32 stays shell-less.
3. CHANGELOG [Unreleased] Fixed note with Refs #6173 #5383 (never Closes/Fixes).
narratives.Acceptance: win32 containedDestExec spawn options include shell:true; non-win32 unchanged; tests prove it; CHANGELOG notes Refs #6173 #5383.

narrative.Acceptance: Given containedDestExec runs on win32, when it execFileSyncs a resolved PM path (including .CMD), then spawn options include shell:true matching the #5383 portable pattern.

items.title: Regression: win32 .CMD gets shell; non-win32 unchanged

narrative.Acceptance: Given mocked execFileSync, when containedDestExec is invoked under win32 with a .CMD file and under non-win32, then win32 options include shell:true and non-win32 does not enable shell.
Given the fix lands, when CHANGELOG [Unreleased] Fixed is updated, then it cites Refs #6173 and #5383 and does not use Fixes/Closes.

expected_outputs: containedDestExec uses shell:true on win32; regression tests pass
